description: #3826 — `list_inherited_tags_for_block` over the DERIVED `block_tag_inherited` table, the one command in this group whose rows the #763 snapshot does not model at all (the snapshot covers blocks / block_properties / block_tags / block_links / op_log). Tagging the PAGE makes its child inherit the tag via `propagate_tag_to_descendants`, and the two steps pin the #1423 contract that the inherited list and the DIRECT list are disjoint: the child holds the tag in one and not the other. The tag edge is driven as an OP over a `page`-typed tag target, the idiom every existing tag fixture uses: a root-level `tag`-typed seed block would take a `page_id` from the raw seed insert that the mock's seed loader does not reproduce, a harness asymmetry unrelated to the command under test.
name: query_inherited_tags

queries.comment: S1 carries the tag directly; S2 is its descendant, so `block_tag_inherited` holds (S2, S3, inherited_from = S1) and the read returns it. Nothing else in the harness observes this table, so without this step the derived cache is unpinned on the mock side entirely.
queries.name: inherited_tag_reaches_the_descendant

queries.comment: The disjointness half of #1423: the same block that inherits S3 holds NO direct tag, so the direct reader answers empty. Meaningful only next to the non-empty step above — together they pin that the two readers do not fall back to one another.
queries.name: inherited_tag_is_not_a_direct_tag
